procedure_column: Liu et al. 2025 (GCA 393) Experimental sulfide Spot analysis ns-LA-Q-ICP-MS Guangzhou Inst. Geochemistry

Procedure Name.cell: Liu et al. (2025) Experimental Sulfide LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
Procedure Name.value: Liu et al. (2025) Experimental Sulfide LA-ICP-MS Spot v1

Procedure Author.cell: Liu, Li, Xu, Xiong et al.
Procedure Author.value: Liu, Li, Xu, Xiong et al.

Laboratory.cell: Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry, CAS; Hefei University of Technology — LA-ICP-MS 'was employed at both the Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry and Hefei University of Technology' (§2.2.2)
Laboratory.value: Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry, CAS; Hefei University of Technology

Funding Source for Procedure Development.cell: N — the CAS Strategic Priority Research Program and NSFC grants support the study as a whole and are recorded under Funding Source for Analysis

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Liu et al. (2025) GCA 393, 170; Xu et al. (2022)
Procedure Reference(s).value: Liu et al. (2025) GCA 393, 170; Xu et al. (2022)

Target Material.cell: experimental sulfide — quench product; pyrrhotite ('po') in the Table 1 notes

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Phase (quenched sulfide of one experimental run) > Spot — "20 μm for sulfides, selecting grain sizes larger than 20 µm for the latter" (p.4); Au and Cu contents are reported per run (Table 1, p.3)
Sampling Unit Type.value: Phase (quenched sulfide of one experimental run) > Spot

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Recovered capsules longitudinally sectioned with a wire saw, and one half mounted in epoxy resin (§2.1)
Sample Preparation Method.value: Recovered capsules longitudinally sectioned with a wire saw, and one half mounted in epoxy resin (§2.1)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Sulfide grains larger than 20 µm, wider than the beam — '20 μm for sulfides, selecting grain sizes larger than 20 µm for the latter' (§2.2.2)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Sulfide grains larger than 20 µm, wider than the beam

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: Optical microscopy, then EMP — "Following examination by optical microscopy to ascertain the integrity of the experiments and the state of the oxygen buffers, the solid components of the run products were analysed for major elements, S and Cu, using a JEOL JXA-8230 electron microprobe (EMP)" (p.2); those EMP values are then the internal standards for the LA data, "with Si and Fe obtained from EMP analyses as the internal standards" (p.4)

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Resonetic 193 nm ArF excimer laser; CetacAnalyte HE system — §2.2.2
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Resonetic 193 nm ArF excimer laser; CetacAnalyte HE system

Ablation Cell Type.cell: N — the paper names the 'CetacAnalyte HE system', not its cell

Laser Spot Geometry.cell: all: 20 µm beam diameter — '20 μm for sulfides, selecting grain sizes larger than 20 µm for the latter' (§2.2.2)

Laser Spot Path / Ablation Mode.cell: N — ablation mode not explicitly stated

Laser Repetition Rate.cell: all: 7 Hz — 'operated at 7 Hz ablation frequency' (§2.2.2)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He; flow not stated — 'Helium served as the carrier gas, to which nitrogen or argon gas was mixed for sensitivity optimization' (§2.2.2)

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: N2 or Ar mixed into the He carrier; amounts not stated — §2.2.2
Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.value: N2 or Ar mixed into the He carrier; amounts not stated

Analysis Sequence.cell: N — NIST 610 is the external standard and NIST 612 and BCR-2G the monitoring standards (§2.2.2); the sequence is not described

Target Species.cell: Au, Cu — 'to determine the Au and Cu contents of the quenched run products' (§2.2.2)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: N — the isotopes measured are not stated

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Au (ppm); Cu (ppm) — Au and Cu contents of the quenched sulfide per run (Table 1, p.3), which with the coexisting glass give the sulfide/melt partition coefficient DAu (dimensionless, p.2)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: all: an element measured by EMP — 'with Si and Fe obtained from EMP analyses as the internal standards' (§2.2.2); which element serves the glass and which the sulfide is not stated

Internal Standard Element.cell: all: Si, Fe — 'Si and Fe obtained from EMP analyses as the internal standards' (§2.2.2); the assignment to glass or sulfide is not stated

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Au micronugget spikes identified in the time-resolved signal and removed, or the analysis not considered — 'only analyses free from micronuggets or where the spikes from the micronuggets could be easily removed were considered (Fig. 1)' (§2.2.2)
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Au micronugget spikes identified in the time-resolved signal and removed, or the analysis not considered

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — no rule for admitting or rejecting individual results is stated. The one documented exclusion is at sample level and before analysis: "Capsules that had lost significant weight were discarded" after the leak check (p.2)

Combination Method.cell: N — Table 1 gives 'one standard deviation' in parentheses, but not what it is taken over

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [Au, Cu: NIST 610] — 'Calibration employed NIST 610 as an external standard' (§2.2.2)

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: NIST 612; BCR-2G — 'NIST 612 and BCR-2G as monitoring standards' (§2.2.2)

Detection Limit.cell: N — detection limits are stated for silicate melts only (§2.2.2)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: N — data from the two laboratories 'exhibited good agreement, any differences being below 10 %' (§2.2.2)

Additional Notes.cell: Run products of 1.0 GPa piston-cylinder experiments, analysed at two laboratories whose data 'exhibited good agreement, any differences being below 10 %' (§2.2.2)
Additional Notes.value: Run products of 1.0 GPa piston-cylinder experiments, analysed at two laboratories whose data 'exhibited good agreement, any differences being below 10 %' (§2.2.2)
